es: Resolver un caso nuevo integrando relato preciso, postura matizada, fuentes atribuidas, plan con condición y una revisión final documentada.

prompt.es: Escribe tu respuesta final (130–210 palabras) con las cinco piezas.

answer.text: Last winter a storm damaged the roof of our neighbourhood library, which nobody had checked for years. Since then, the library has been closed. If the council had repaired the roof earlier, the library would still be open now, and I wish it had done so. The roof must have been weak for a long time, so the damage was probably predictable. According to the mayor, the repairs will start in May, but residents claim that they have been waiting for a year. The mayor is also said to have promised a new roof twice. Although money is tight, we could reopen one small room provided that volunteers help with the cleaning. If the council agrees, we will meet next week and sign a plan. In my final check, I changed 'was' to 'had been' in the first sentence to show which event came first, and I added although to link my last two ideas.

origin.text: Caso nuevo: una tormenta dañó el tejado de la biblioteca del barrio, que nadie había revisado en años; hoy está cerrada. El alcalde dice que las obras empezarán en mayo; los vecinos aseguran que llevan un año esperando. Escribe: 1) lo ocurrido, con pasado y pasado perfecto, más un condicional o un deseo; 2) tu postura con una deducción o un matiz; 3) dos fuentes atribuidas; 4) un plan con condición, concesión y futuro; 5) una línea final que diga qué revisaste y por qué.
